rdf:Description.dc:title: Video of Moratorium to End the War in Vietnam
rdf:Description.dc:description: The Moratorium to End the War in Vietnam took place in November, 1969. Thousands of people came to Washington to protest the Vietnam War, meeting throughout the city but especially on the National Mall. This video shows protesters gathered near the Washington Monument and in front of the National Archives.
rdf:Description.dc:source: National Archives at College Park. View original.
